name: appbase-monorepo
description: AppBase Core and the apps built on it. Each package keeps its own dependencies.

scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix packages/core && npm ci --prefix apps/fittimer
scripts.fittimer:check: npm --prefix apps/fittimer run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/fittimer run test:boundaries && npm --prefix apps/fittimer run test:foundation && npm --prefix apps/fittimer run check:sources && npm --prefix apps/fittimer run build && npm --prefix apps/fittimer run check:mobile
scripts.check: npm run core:check && npm run fittimer:check
